newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SJ to sell Swebus to Stagecoach for 2.4 bln skr.
newsitem.headline: SJ to sell Swebus to Stagecoach for 2.4 bln skr.

text.p: Swedish state railway company Statens Jarnvagar (SJ) said on Tuesday it was selling its bus unit Swebus to British bus operator Stagecoach for 2.4 billion crowns ($361.6 million).
The company told a press conference that Stagecoach would take over a 1.18 billion crowns debt held by Swebus, which is the Nordic region's biggest bus company. ($ = 6.637 Swedish Crowns)
SJ to sell Swebus to Stagecoach for 2.4 bln =2
Stagecoach announced in July that it would sign a letter of intent with SJ subsidiary Swedcarrier to buy Swebus.
Swebus has around 3,500 buses in operation in Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark.
